title: गोरखाको इतिहासमा पालुङ्टारको महत्त्व (Importance of Palungtar in the History of Gorkha)
nepali: गोरखाको इतिहासमा पालुङ्टारको महत्त्व बताउने क्रममा गोरखा जिल्लाको परिचय, गोरखाको नामकरण, जिल्ला हिमाल, पहाड र टारमा विभाजन, चेपे नदीको ऐतिहासिक महत्त्व, नदीको नामकरण सम्बन्धी तथा राजा छान्ने अनौठो चलन, राजा यशोब्रह्म शाह तथा दुई रानीहरुको बारेमा वर्णन तथा चम्पावती पुत्र प्राप्ति, दान धर्म, गौदान सम्बन्धी वर्णन तथा लिगलिग कोटका सामरिक एवम् ऐतिहासिक महत्त्वको बारेमा र चेपे किनारमा सिमाना सम्बन्धी सन्धि साथै थुमहरुको वर्णन तथा द्रव्य शाहले जालझेल गरी गोरखा राज्य स्थापना सहित पालुङ्टारको नामकरण आदिको बारेमा वर्णन गर्ने जमर्को गरिएको छ ।
american_english: In the course of explaining the importance of Palungtar in the history of Gorkha, an endeavor has been made to describe an introduction to Gorkha district, the naming of Gorkha, the division of the district into Himalayas, hills, and plateau (tar), the historical importance of the Chepe River, matters concerning the naming of the river along with the unusual custom of choosing a king, descriptions regarding King Yashobrahma Shah and the two queens as well as Champawati obtaining a son, descriptions regarding religious charity, cow-donation (gaudan), and regarding the strategic and historical importance of Ligligkot, and the border treaty on the banks of the Chepe along with a description of the thums (fortified ridges), and regarding the naming of Palungtar together with the establishment of the Gorkha state by Dravya Shah through deceit, among other topics.
